x: Organiser of this race, on behalf of the Smiths Sports and Social Club, is none other than our old international, Verne Blowfield. Most of us remember Verne for that classic National C.C. he nearly won in 1948-it was only in the closing stages that Sydney Wooderson passed him.
1948 Verne Blowfield 35th To those who do not remember the days of food rationing, it might be of interest to quote the following minute from the E.C.C.U's A.G.M. of 1948.

VERNE BLOWFIELD, Belgrave's most forward placed runner ever in the National (he was passed by Sydney Wooderson in the closing stages of the 1948 Championship when victory seemed in his grasp) was placed second in a Veterans AC cross-country handicap on October 18th from a mark of 5:30.
Nevertheless, to join the ever-present Carter, Penny and Stimpson we were delighted to receive Verne Blowfield who was visiting Belgrave Hall again for the first time in 37 years!
